lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. You’re not alone, and this is still an emergency. Please call nine one one now and say: “I’m two weeks postpartum, bleeding, and I had a thought of hurting myself.” You said you’re in Medford, so tell them your exact location at the shelter door. If your hands are shaky, ask someone next to you to call nine one one for you right now.
originalTexts: Thank you for telling me. You’re not alone, and this is still an emergency. Please call **911 now** and say: “I’m two weeks postpartum, bleeding, and I had a thought of hurting myself.” You said you’re in Medford, so tell them your exact location at the shelter door. If your hands are shaky, ask someone next to you to call **911** for you right now.
